channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: The war in the Gulf will have to end in compromise
item.description: Iran has not surrendered, and the war’s original aims remain unmet.

item.title: Russian drone attack kills two at Ukraine-Moldova border crossing
item.description: Russian drones strike Ukraine-Moldova border in Odesa, killing two and injuring three civilians, officials confirm.

item.title: Medicine shortages grow in Iran as US tightens sanctions, blockade
item.description: Many Iranians cannot access or afford life-saving drugs, but authorities say pharmaceutical sector will not collapse.

item.title: Why US-Iran war over Hormuz is threatening the Gulf’s waters
item.description: US-Iran attacks on tankers around Hormuz are raising fears of devastating oil spills across the Gulf.

item.title: Oil hits $100 a barrel for first time since July after US and Houthi strikes
item.description: Brent crude - the global benchmark for prices - rises after the US hit five Iranian tankers on Tuesday

item.title: Ukrainian TV channel building hit by Russian drone as five killed in Kyiv
item.description: President Zelensky describes the daytime drone attack in Ukraine's capital as a "new page in Russian degradation"

item.title: Saudi Arabia vows to respond after Houthis attack cities and energy facilities
item.description: The Iran-backed Yemeni group's attacks have injured 73 people and caused fires at oil facilities, Saudi authorities say.

item.title: British-Israeli relations at lowest ebb in decades
item.description: Israel's response to London's trade ban with Israeli settlements in the occupied West Bank shows how important this moment is.

item.title: Where is Israel's proposed West Bank settlement the UK opposes?
item.description: BBC's Middle East correspondent Lucy Williamson reports from an area close to Israel's proposed site in the occupied West Bank.

item.title: Pupils return to West Bank school behind barbed wire to protect against settlers
item.description: Six people, including three pupils at the Palestinian school, have been killed in al-Mughayyir this year, in a surge of Israeli settler-related violence.
